candidates.statement: Checkout 502s (~2s each) trace to order's POST payment call to payment /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout after ~2s, while inventory/redis succeed; payment is the slow downstream causing gateway checkout failures.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side latency metrics or logs; payment timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every failed checkout correlates with a payment authorization ReadTimeout (~2s), matching the ~2s 502 durations; inventory/redis calls succeed. Gateway metrics show /v1/checkout p95 ~2406ms and 502s. Payment is the bounded downstream latency source.
